emptyColNote: Note: empty columns cannot be refilled

tutorial.foundation: Build 4 foundation piles by suit from Ace to King.
tutorial.tableau: 13 tableau columns of 4 cards each. Kings are automatically moved to the bottom at deal time.
tutorial.moves: Move single cards onto any card one rank lower (suit doesn't matter). Empty columns cannot be filled.
tutorial.controls: Use hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

hintReason.toFoundation: Send this card to the foundation to free up the column.
hintReason.toTableau: Apply the suggested tableau move to unlock buried cards.
